brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net dont know if you can read the alt text in this quoted post? Can you create an online metronome site please?

Tempo control, tap tempo, drop down time signature selection, sub divisions, visual feedback

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @words.bsky.social: little bit cut off screen shot

prompts in alt text 

gemini made a full html file I can message you if you want

vibecoding music tools is really transformative 

the machine knows the theory you just need to know what you want (image, alt text: "Create a fully functional, professional-grade metronome application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (Web Audio API). The app should be responsive, mobile-friendly, and include the following features:
Tempo Control: A slider and number input for BPM (range: 30–280).
Tap Tempo: A button to set the BPM by tapping.
Time Signatures: A dropdown to select common signatures (2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/8).
Subdivisions: Options for quarter notes, eighth notes, triplets, and sixteenth notes.
Visual Feedback: A large visual 'beat counter' or progress bar that flashes on the downbeat (Beat 1) in a different color than the subsequent beats.
Sound Design: Use the Web Audio API to generate a high-pitched 'pip' for the downbeat and a lower-pitched 'pop' for other beats. Include a volume slider.
Setlist Mode: A simple feature to save 'presets' (e.g., 'Song 1: 120 BPM, 4/4').
Please provide the code in a single file or a structured set (HTML/JS/CSS) so I can run it immediately in a browser.")]
note: built a real metronome: tap tempo, 2/4-6/8 time signatures, quarter/eighth/triplet/16th subdivisions, a flashing downbeat, and a setlist to save your song tempos. no gemini required.
